stem: Carbon and silicon are elements in Group 14.

parts.label: (a)
parts.stem: $\text{C}_{60}$ and diamond are allotropes of carbon.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Describe the lattice structure of solid $\text{C}_{60}$.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
$\text{C}_{60}$ sublimes (turns directly from solid to gas) at about $800\text{ K}$. Diamond also sublimes but only above $3800\text{ K}$.

Explain why $\text{C}_{60}$ and diamond sublime at such different temperatures.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: $\text{C}_{60}$ forms hydrocarbons with similar chemical properties to those of alkenes. One such hydrocarbon is $\text{C}_{60}\text{H}_{18}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: State what is meant by the term *hydrocarbon*.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Describe a test to indicate the presence of double bonds between carbon atoms in $\text{C}_{60}\text{H}_{18}$. Give the result of the test.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem:
$0.144\text{ g}$ of $\text{C}_{60}$ was placed in a $100\text{ cm}^3$ container of hydrogen gas at $20^{\circ}\text{C}$ and $1.00 \times 10^5\text{ Pa}$.

The container was heated to make the $\text{C}_{60}$ and hydrogen gas react.

The reaction occurred as shown in the equation.

$$\text{C}_{60}(\text{s}) + x\text{H}_2(\text{g}) \rightarrow \text{C}_{60}\text{H}_{2x}(\text{s})$$

After the reaction, the container was allowed to cool to $20^{\circ}\text{C}$. The pressure decreased to $2.21 \times 10^4\text{ Pa}$. All of the $\text{C}_{60}$ had reacted.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Name the type of reaction that occurred.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Calculate the amount, in moles, of $\text{C}_{60}$ that reacted.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Calculate the amount, in moles, of hydrogen gas that reacted with the $\text{C}_{60}$.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text:
Use your answers from (ii) and (iii) to deduce the molecular formula of the hydrocarbon, $\text{C}_{60}\text{H}_{2x}$.

If you were unable to calculate the amount of hydrogen gas, assume that $0.00240\text{ mol}$ of hydrogen gas reacted. This is **not** the correct value for the amount of hydrogen gas that reacted.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem: Silicon shows the same kind of bonding and structure as diamond.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.text: State the type of bonding and structure shown by silicon.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text:
When silicon reacts with magnesium, $\text{Mg}_2\text{Si}$ forms. $\text{Mg}_2\text{Si}$ is thought to contain the $\text{Si}^{4-}$ ion.

State the full electronic configuration of the $\text{Si}^{4-}$ ion.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text:
Solid $\text{Mg}_2\text{Si}$ reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid to form gaseous $\text{SiH}_4$ and a solution of magnesium chloride.

Write an equation to show the reaction of solid $\text{Mg}_2\text{Si}$ with dilute hydrochloric acid.

Include state symbols.

parts.label: (d)(iv)
parts.text: Predict the shape of the $\text{SiH}_4$ molecule.

parts.label: (d)(v)
parts.text:
$\text{SiH}_4$ reacts spontaneously with oxygen to produce a white solid and a colourless liquid that turns anhydrous copper(II) sulfate blue. No other products are formed.

Write an equation for the reaction of $\text{SiH}_4$ with oxygen.

State symbols are **not** required.
